top_issues.issue: Buttons have no single system: filled primaries render ~15pt bold while outlined secondaries are 13pt; secondary buttons come in three styles (outlined #8a8d95, filled borderless pill #eeeef0 e.g. 'Copy link'/'Restore', and faint-bordered #dfdfe3 'Reply'/reaction chips); disabled Save/Join are 15pt grey slabs.
top_issues.evidence: 'Sign in with Microsoft' cap height visibly larger than 'Use a code instead'; Cancel border #8a8d95 3.32:1 vs Reply border #dfdfe3 1.33:1 (dark #303137 on #25262b 1.16:1).
top_issues.fix: One button component: 13pt semibold, 32px tall, 12px horizontal padding, 6px radius. Primary = #a9530f fill/white (light), #e88c3e/#1c1208 (dark). Secondary = transparent fill + 1px #8a8d95 (light) / #6e7179 (dark). Use the same secondary for Reply, Copy link, Restore, Close bar.

top_issues.issue: Message hover toolbar overlaps neighbouring rows (mention highlight above, previous reaction chips, the post's own name row).
top_issues.evidence: group-chat toolbar y388-425 overlaps the mention row ending ~y399; chats-narrow toolbar y278-314 touches '❤ 1' chip at y262-284; channel-narrow toolbar covers name row y56-90.
top_issues.fix: Anchor the toolbar inside the hovered row: top = row.top + 4, right = row.right - 8; give rows min 8px top padding so it never crosses into another row; or place it at row.top - 18 only when the row above has no highlight.

top_issues.issue: Shortcut descriptions are not aligned on one column; each section sizes its own key column.
top_issues.fix: Use one grid for all sections with the key column fixed at 190px (widest chip set + 12px), so descriptions start at x=612 everywhere; keep 24px bottom margin to the window.

top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with wide side bearings across the app ('On - call', 'go/no - go', 'Step - by - step', 'Sign - in', 'F4KQ - 9TZW').
top_issues.evidence: Zoomed crops show ~3px gaps either side of the hyphen at 13-14pt Inter, unlike normal kerning.
top_issues.fix: Stop substituting U+2011 (non-breaking hyphen) or map it to Inter's U+002D glyph; if a fallback font supplies U+2011, replace with U+002D plus a no-break rule in layout.

top_issues.issue: Interactive outlines below 3:1: hover toolbar, reaction chips and Reply buttons.
top_issues.evidence: Toolbar #dfdfe3 on #f6f6f7 1.23:1, dark #303137 on #1d1e22 1.28:1; reaction chip 1.33/1.37:1; Reply 1.33/1.16:1.
top_issues.fix: Use the control border token (#8a8d95 light 3.3:1, #6e7179 dark 3.1-3.6:1) for interactive outlines; keep #dfdfe3/#303137 only for passive cards.

top_issues.issue: At 1920 wide the message column and composer cap at ~920px but the header actions stay at the window's right edge.
top_issues.evidence: Messages/composer end at x~1296; call/video/pop-out icons at x~1820-1890.
top_issues.fix: Apply the same max width (e.g. 960px content + 16px gutters) to the header, or let the column grow to 1100px and align header actions to the column's right edge.

top_issues.issue: Calls page controls and text don't match the rest of the app: Join button taller and offset from the input, body text larger, broken hanging indent at narrow width.
top_issues.evidence: Input y125-154 vs Join y125-157; body copy ~15pt vs 14pt elsewhere; 'window' wraps to x=321 under the X icon.
top_issues.fix: Input and button both 32px, vertically centred in one row with 8px gap; body copy 14pt; indent wrapped capability lines to the text start (x+22).

top_issues.issue: Error toast is centred on the window, not the message pane, and covers the first visible message.
top_issues.evidence: Toast spans x393-887 (centre 640) while the pane spans x364-1280 (centre 822).
top_issues.fix: Centre toasts in the content pane, 12px under the header, max width min(560px, pane-48px); or dock bottom-centre above the composer.

top_issues.issue: Long draft scroll indicator is a tiny bar floating beside the attach icon; top line is clipped mid-glyph.
top_issues.evidence: 6x18px thumb at x~1181,y~737; first line 'SELECT column_110' cut at y~556.
top_issues.fix: Put a 4px scrollbar along the composer's inner right edge spanning the text area; add a 12px top fade; cap composer at 40% of pane height.

top_issues.issue: Pasted-image thumbnails centre-crop wide images into unrecognisable fragments and show no name/size.
top_issues.evidence: 3072x256 strip shows half birds in all three 144x96 tiles.
top_issues.fix: Use contain fit on a neutral #eeeef0/#2c2d33 tile with 4px padding, and add an 11pt caption 'image.png · 84 KB' under each tile like the PDF chip.

top_issues.issue: Chat list width jumps to 220px and loses its filter on an empty account.
top_issues.evidence: List column x64-284 vs x64-364 on every other chat screen.
top_issues.fix: Keep the list at 300px with the filter field (disabled) and a one-line 'No chats yet' note at 12pt.

top_issues.issue: At 760px the rail + sidebar keep 296px (39%), truncating names and squeezing content.
top_issues.fix: Below 900px window width shrink the list to 240px (avatars 32px) or collapse it behind a toggle; on Calls show call/video actions on hover only.

top_issues.issue: Image preview toolbar is inconsistent and incomplete.
top_issues.evidence: 'Fit' is a filled chip, '100%' plain ~15pt text; no file name, Save, Copy or Open actions.
top_issues.fix: Segmented control with two equal 28px segments at 13pt; title = file name; right-side icon buttons Save, Copy, Open externally.

top_issues.issue: Settings content clipped at the dialog bottom with no fade/footer; uneven section spacing.
top_issues.evidence: 'Move Wren beside the call window' row cut at y~718; 12px vs 20px above section headers.
top_issues.fix: Add a 16px bottom fade and 24px inner bottom padding; use 20px above every section header and 8px between header and first control.

top_issues.issue: Status message uses a two-line textarea and a disabled Save that leads the button row.
top_issues.evidence: Textarea 50px tall; Save filled grey at 15pt before an outlined 13pt Cancel.
top_issues.fix: Single-line 32px input with a 280-char counter, 'Clear after' dropdown, and buttons right-aligned Cancel then Save.

top_issues.issue: 'Be right back' and 'Appear away' use the same icon and colour.
top_issues.evidence: Both rows show the yellow ring at x~79.
top_issues.fix: Use a clock glyph for Be right back and the yellow ring for Away, matching Teams' presence semantics.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is a sparse 640px island with a redundant field and an unlabelled sentence.
top_issues.fix: Drop Location when it equals the online provider; label the join note; show attendees/description; let the card grow to 760px.

top_issues.issue: Sign-in pages are top-heavy: the logo is pinned at y=60 and content ends near y=575, leaving 225-390px empty below.
top_issues.evidence: signin-finishing content ends at y=420 of 800.
top_issues.fix: Vertically centre the logo+card+footer group, with a min top margin of 48px.

top_issues.issue: Loading shows two spinners and enabled refresh/compose; skeleton bars are barely visible.
top_issues.evidence: Spinner at (231,26) and centre; skeleton #e4e4e8 on #f6f6f7 1.17:1, dark #34353c on #1d1e22 1.36:1.
top_issues.fix: Keep the centre spinner only, disable refresh while syncing, darken skeletons to #dcdce0 / #3a3b42.
